title: Host down, scrape target unreachable
symptoms: Target web-05:9100 is down. up == 0 for node-exporter. Host does not respond to ping or SSH.
root_cause: The machine crashed, lost power or network, or node-exporter itself stopped.
impact: Services on that host are unavailable; load moves to other hosts.
fix_steps: Try SSH and ping; check the cloud console for host status.
Reboot the host or restart node-exporter.
Replace the instance if the hardware failed.
prevention: Spread services across hosts and use auto-healing instance groups.
